estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Meat doneness was weakly and inconsistently associated with prostate cancer risk for individual types of meat, but increased risk was observed for well-done beefsteak (relative risk = 1.68; 95% confidence interval = 1.02-2.77; two-sided P for trend =.03).
estimate_classifications.reason: The well-done beefsteak estimate is for prostate cancer generally, with no stage, grade, metastatic, or lethal restriction.
